quarterly_data.signal: Sumitomo Metal Mining and Mitsubishi Gas Chemical announce that GRANOPT Co., Ltd., their joint venture, has decided to triple its production capacity for Faraday rotators by the fiscal year ending March 31, 2028 (FY2027) compared with FY2025. The release states no investment amount, unit volumes or customers.
